How we check

Our rule is simple: we only show a fact if we can point to where it came from. If we can't confirm something, we say "Unknown" rather than guess.

Where the data comes from

  • Which products are listed, and their features: HMRC's software finder for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, using the full list for sole traders and landlords. Last read on 18 November 2026: 179 products. This gives us whether there's a free version, whether it creates records or bridges to spreadsheets, which income sources it supports, what it can submit, MTD for VAT, HMRC Assist, accessibility features and the status of each tax-return item.
  • Prices: read by us on each provider's own pricing page. Each product page shows the date checked and links to the page. We note introductory offers separately from the regular price. So far we've checked 31 products, starting with the best-known names and those people ask about most on forums.
  • Joint property support: shown as "Yes" only when the provider's own site says it splits income and expenses between joint owners. HMRC's finder doesn't record this. See our jointly owned property guide.
  • CIS: "CIS on tax return" is HMRC's status for reporting Construction Industry Scheme deductions on your tax return. It doesn't mean the software files contractor CIS returns.
  • Thresholds and dates: taken directly from GOV.UK and linked wherever they appear.

Order and independence

The directory is in alphabetical order by default, and you can re-sort it yourself. We never order, include or leave out a product because of a commission. Products without an affiliate deal get the same treatment as those with one.

Which pages search engines see

Every HMRC-recognised product has a page. Pages for products we haven't price-checked yet are kept out of search results until we've added checked information, so we don't publish thin pages.

Keeping it up to date

We re-read HMRC's list and re-check prices regularly. If you spot something out of date, email customerservices@mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk and we will correct it.
